premises.text: Organizers and members currently must use five different systems to run and engage a community
premises.evidence_span: thousands of people have had to sign up for five different systems in order to engage our group

premises.text: Cohort consolidates communication, events, members, and transactions into one organizer solution
premises.evidence_span: Communication management, event management, member management, transaction management, under one umbrella

premises.text: Custom application forms let organizers target subsets of members for communications and events
premises.evidence_span: we give organizers custom application forms. These forms are forms that members fill out when they join the group. This enables organizers to target communication and events at specific subsets of their population

premises.text: Advanced ticketing supports multiple ticket types, rates, release dates, and public vs member sales
premises.evidence_span: you'll be able to create numerous ticket types, student, alumni, employee, charge different rates for every ticket, release them on different dates, and make them available to both members and people from the general public

premises.text: Groups can manage multi-tier chapters/subgroups online with full local tools
premises.evidence_span: Each group can have as many subgroups as they want and as many tiers of subgroups as they need. Each subgroup has all the tools I just described

premises.text: Channels curate groups by interest topic for discovery
premises.evidence_span: This makes it easy for users to find the great groups and events in their interest topic

premises.text: Revenue model mixes free groups with channel subscriptions, premium subscriptions, and transaction fees
premises.evidence_span: We generate revenue by selling subscriptions against our channels in free groups. We generate subscription revenue for our premium groups. And we generate service fees revenue at any time we conduct a transaction

value.text: Catch-all community platform for any type of group organizer and members
value.evidence_span: Cohort is the catch-all for all things community

causal_links.evidence_span: the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership
We also connect groups to their chapters
for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free

notes: Split ticketing and application forms as product conditions that could fail separately from the umbrella claim. Privacy toggles folded into hierarchy/discovery narrative rather than a separate premise. Anti-template: three domains are organizer product, structure/discovery, and money with transcript warrant.
